definitions.gloss: coloured and patterned items; non-white laundry
definitions.explanation: Clothes, towels, and linens that are dyed or printed rather than plain white. A laundry-care term: these are washed separately from whites because the dye can run.

examples.japanese: {色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}→漂白剤：07035_hyouhakuzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This bleach can't be used on coloured or patterned items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色|いろ}{落|お}ち→色落ち：20012_iroochi⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{単独|たんどく}→単独：05613_tandoku⟧で⟦{洗濯|せんたく}した→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: New coloured items bleed easily, so it's best to wash them on their own the first few times.

notes:
From ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (colour) plus ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ (pattern) plus ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (item). Learners meet it on detergent bottles and washing-machine instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白物|しろもの}→白物：30774_shiromono⟧: coloureds and whites
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧: detergent for coloured items
- {色柄物|いろがらもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧{洗|あら}い: wash coloureds separately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白物|しろもの}→白物：30774_shiromono⟧: whites — the counterpart in the same laundry instructions
- ⟦{色|いろ}{落|お}ち→色落ち：20012_iroochi⟧: colour running, fading — what these instructions are trying to prevent
- ⟦{柄物|がらもの}→柄物：21181_garamono⟧: patterned item — the pattern alone, with no comment on colour
